stable.notes: Work brings existing tasks into domain boards with Mentioned, Planned, Draft, Built, QA and Complete. Review a saved meeting when you choose, inspect confirmed source links and recorded handoffs, then explicitly Continue, Fork or start a new agent session with reviewed context. Work does not automatically prepare or publish anything. Fresh installations use the packaged task runtime and require Python 3.10 or later; configured COS task bridges remain authoritative. Pairs with server 6.56.0. Existing glasses Tasks clients remain compatible; the new glasses Work candidate requires device acceptance.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
